newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Telecom Italia 1996 result in line with 1st half.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia 1996 result in line with 1st half.

text.p: Telecom Italia Mobile CEO Vito Gamberale said on Monday he expected the company's 1996 earning results to be in line with those of the first half of the year.
Gamberale also said that the company had broken even on its GSM mobile services in the first half of the year and made 100 billion lire in gross profits in the first nine months.
Telecom Italia Mobile, Europe's largest mobile phone group, reported a 48 percent jump in profits in the first half of 1996.
"We are confident we will follow in this direction (for the whole year)," Gamberale told a news briefing. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2986830
